## About
Together, Houston’s Memorial Oaks Funeral Home and Memorial Oaks Cemetery offer an array of funeral, cremation and cemetery services to meet the needs of families in the Greater Houston area. With compassionate teams experienced at handling all kinds of requests with patience and professionalism, the funeral home and cemetery serve many Houston neighborhoods, including Memorial, the Energy Corridor, Jersey Village, Spring Branch and Katy.
From spacious chapel and reception spaces replete with modern amenities to breathtaking cemetery estates, private mausoleums, cemetery plots and cremation gardens, we can accommodate any request.
## Traditional and personalized funeral services
![]()Memorial Oaks Funeral Home is committed to creating a meaningful funeral experience for you and your loved ones. We do that by tailoring our services to each individual. For someone, that might mean a witness cremation with a[traditional funeral](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/memorial-services/planning-a-funeral/traditional-funeral)service, often in accordance with religious and cultural customs. For another, it could mean a contemporary[celebration of life](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/memorial-services/planning-a-celebration-of-life/celebration-of-life). We believe everyone should have the memorial service they desire.
We find ways to[personalize a funeral](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/memorial-services/planning-a-celebration-of-life/celebration-of-life)service to reflect the passions and beliefs of the person being honored because every life has its own beauty. If you’re interested in customizing a funeral, simply let us know. We’ll work with you to figure out how to do that with just the right touch, from a butterfly release to a barbecue, a sports-themed event to an art show.
## Our spacious chapel and funeral home
Memorial Oaks Funeral Home has a large chapel that serves all faiths. The chapel has pew seating and a capacity for up to 250 people, making it ideal for larger funerals. It’s wheelchair accessible, which is an important consideration for friends and family with mobility concerns.
The chapel has a warm, elegant feel with tones of white, cream, wood and gold. Although the chapel is traditional in architecture, its state-of-the-art audio/visual equipment supports multimedia memorial presentations (which we can help you create).
We have 4 staterooms—Pine Oak, Right Oak, White Oak and Live Oak—used most often for visitations before funeral services. We’re happy to find the one that’s right for your family’s needs. We also have a comfortable living room with plush couches and a coffee bar so you can sit with your family to talk through the many decisions that arise when arranging a funeral, whether at the[time of need](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/immediate-need)or[in advance](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/pre-need).
Over the past decade, we have made many updates and modernized the funeral home, including adding a space for catered events.
## Reception space
![]()Memorial Oaks Funeral Home recently opened an event space to give families a convenient option for catered receptions. With the capacity to serve up to 100 people, the space includes a grand piano, full bar and 60-inch TV to show slideshows and videos during a reception.
Our caterer will work with you to create a menu suited to your family's tastes and dietary restrictions. We can arrange anything from a casual wine-and-cheese evening to a formal sit-down meal with fine china and waitstaff. The choice is yours.
## Here when you need us
As a member of the Dignity Memorial®network, Memorial Oaks Funeral Home gives you not only the warm, familiar attention you expect from a Houston funeral home but also the value you deserve by way of the largest network of funeral, cremation and cemetery service providers in North America. We invite you to call us for immediate assistance or to learn more about planning ahead.
## Memorial Oaks Cemetery
With more than 70 acres of beautiful and varied landscape, Memorial Oaks Cemetery has served some of Houston's best-known families. Our compassionate, professional team treats each family as if it were our own, with loving care and professionalism.
Memorial Oaks Cemetery has a selection of tranquil settings, soothing waterscapes, meticulously maintained grounds and grand structures. These elements give families areas for meditation and reflection on the lives of those who meant so much.
### Reflection Lake Estates
![Cemetery Entrance at Reflection Lake Estates at Memorial Oaks]()With the palatial Texas Liberty Mausoleum, the exquisite Robert L. Waltrip Memorial Chapel and a serene lake as its centerpiece, Reflection Lake Estates is perhaps the most beautiful section of the Memorial Oaks Funeral Home & Cemetery property. Created by the finest designers, developers and landscape architects, these 26 acres offer an exclusive experience replete with elegant details that provide the perfect environment to honor discerning legacies. While pictures certainly give you an idea, nothing can convey the true grace of Reflection Lake Estates like a private tour. Contact us and we will be happy to arrange for someone to show you around.
### Private mausoleums
![Mausoleum at Memorial Oaks Cemetery]()At Memorial Oaks, you have the opportunity to build your own private mausoleum. Exclusive, built-to-suit sites are located within Lakeside Estates. You can choose from several estate options, including private family estates, private family mausoleums, bench estates and lawn crypts. Our commitment to design standards ensures the beauty of the grounds and surrounding estates will be upheld for generations to come.
### More sections for memorialization
![Columbarium at Memorial Oaks Cemetery]()Whispering Water Estates blends a waterfall with private family estates. A relaxing, garden-like ambiance is achieved in other parts with bench estates and boulder estates. Turkey Creek Estates combines hedged private estates, gated walled estates and family bench estates, creating dramatic, dignified memorials. For those who choose cremation, Memorial Oaks has a beautiful botanical garden with carefully considered touches.
## We care for Houston
Memorial Oaks Funeral Home and Memorial Oaks Cemetery are deeply committed to Houston. Both teams put on a variety of events throughout the year. On the 1st Tuesday in December, we have a joint night of music and remembrance for people to gather and support one another during the holiday season. We also offer an Easter sunrise service every spring on the eastern cove of Reflection Lake.
Memorial Oaks Funeral Home & Memorial Oaks Cemetery support charitable causes and participate in events with the[American Diabetes" Association](http://www.diabetes.org/),[United Way](https://www.unitedway.org/)and[Donate Life America.](https://www.donatelife.net/)
## ![]()We honor veterans
Memorial Oaks Funeral Home and Memorial Oaks Cemetery understand the unique needs of America’s veterans and their families. As Level One Founding Community Partners with[We Honor Veterans](https://www.wehonorveterans.org), our staff is knowledgeable in the benefits available to veterans and their families. With respect, integrity and dignity, we will walk you through the steps of creating a[veteran's memorial service](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/veterans)that truly honors the life and sacrifice of your loved one.
We also salute our troops whenever possible. On Memorial Day, we host the Tribute to Heroes and Freedom event to honor servicemen and servicewomen. This patriotic occasion includes a flyover of vintage Air Force planes, an orchestra and a keynote speaker.
## Caring for Houston families since 1955
Established in 1955, Memorial Oaks Cemetery has long been an important resource for the Houston community. It is the final resting place of many prominent Houstonians and people from all walks of life. As you enter the grounds, the first thing you will notice is the Memorial Oaks coach. Built in 1867, the classic, horse-drawn coach was likely in service into the early part of the 20th century. This recognizable artifact serves as a reminder of Memorial Oaks Cemetery's rich history and tradition.
Memorial Oaks Funeral Home opened on the cemetery property in the early 1990s. Both Memorial Oaks Funeral Home & Memorial Oaks Cemetery continually make improvements to give Houston families the best experience.

## Acerca de

For generations, Memorial Oaks Funeral Home & Cemetery has been a trusted place for Houston families to find both comfort and care. We believe every farewell should be as unique as the life it honors, and our team is here to walk beside you with compassion, tradition and a personal touch. From tranquil gardens to beautifully designed spaces for gathering, we offer a setting where you can remember and celebrate with the people you love.

## Personalized services for every family

Every family’s needs are different, which is why we offer both traditional and contemporary services. Some families choose a witness cremation followed by a funeral in keeping with cultural customs. Others prefer a vibrant celebration of life with music and favorite foods. However you wish to say goodbye, we’ll help you create a service that reflects your loved one’s passions and beliefs. Ver másVer menos

As a Level One Founding Community Partner with We Honor Veterans, we also specialize in creating meaningful tributes for those who have served our country. From military honors at the graveside to thoughtfully planned veterans memorials, we are committed to honoring service with dignity and respect. Ver másVer menos

## Thoughtfully designed spaces

Memorial Oaks Funeral Home was designed to feel both elegant and welcoming. The all-faith chapel seats up to 250 guests, with timeless architecture, natural light and state-of-the-art audio/visual equipment for slideshows, video tributes or personalized playlists. Four staterooms offer a more intimate setting for smaller services, while our cozy living room and coffee bar provide a relaxed space for reflection. Ver másVer menos

Families often choose to continue gathering in our reception area, which accommodates up to 100 guests. Whether it’s a casual breakfast buffet or a formal dinner, we’ll arrange catering that reflects your family’s tastes and traditions, so you can spend more time together sharing memories. Ver másVer menos

## A peaceful memorial park

Memorial Oaks Cemetery spans more than 100 acres of rolling lawns, native trees, fountains and carefully tended gardens. Families can choose from a variety of settings, each designed to bring peace and comfort. Ver másVer menos

- Reflection Lake Estates features the Texas Liberty Mausoleum, the Robert L. Waltrip Memorial Chapel, and a serene lake at its center—creating one of the most beautiful areas of the cemetery.
- Whispering Water Estates blends a graceful waterfall with private family estates.
- Turkey Creek Estates offers hedged and walled estates for privacy and dignity.
- For those who prefer cremation, our botanical garden provides a natural setting for remembrance.

You may also choose to create a private mausoleum or family estate within Lakeside Estates. Built-to-suit sites ensure a lasting legacy while upholding the beauty and harmony of the memorial park for generations to come. Ver másVer menos

## Connected to our community

At Memorial Oaks, we believe in lifting our community up. Each year, we host gatherings that bring people together in reflection and hope. Ver másVer menos

- In December, our Evening of Music and Remembrance offers families a chance to honor loved ones during the holiday season.
- Each spring, we gather at the eastern cove of Reflection Lake for our Easter Sunrise Service, a moving time of worship and renewal.
- On Memorial Day, our Tribute to Heroes and Freedom honors servicemen and servicewomen with a flyover of vintage Air Force planes, live orchestra music and a keynote speaker.

Beyond these events, we support charitable causes close to our hearts, including the American Diabetes Association, United Way and Donate Life America. By giving back, we hope to strengthen the same community that has entrusted us for generations. Ver másVer menos

## A legacy of care

Since 1955, Memorial Oaks Cemetery has served Houston families as a place of lasting remembrance. The cemetery entrance features a treasured artifact: an 1867 horse-drawn hearse preserved in a glass enclosure, a reminder of our enduring history and traditions. Ver másVer menos

In the early 1990s, Memorial Oaks Funeral Home was added to the property, bringing modern comforts to the historic grounds. Together, the funeral home and cemetery continue to serve Houston families with the same dedication, compassion and dignity that began more than half a century ago.

We invite you to visit us and see how we’re different. We’d love to get to know you. Ver másVer menos
